tool-inventory-connect-link.title: Tool selected in the terminal
tool-inventory-connect-link.description: Check the latest report for this worker and command before opening Quick Connect.
tool-inventory-connect-link.invalid: This link is incomplete or belongs to a different project. Generate a new link from the intended project.
tool-inventory-connect-link.stale: There is no fresh report for this worker. Wait for the worker to report again, then retry this check.
tool-inventory-connect-link.changed: The command is unavailable or its configuration has changed. Review the worker inventory in the terminal and generate a new link.
tool-inventory-connect-link.adapter_unav: The current tool catalog has no single Quick Connect entry for this configuration.
tool-inventory-connect-link.access_denie: Your current account cannot read this tool selection in this project.
tool-inventory-connect-link.read_failed: The current tool selection could not be checked. Try again.
